Name: HVAC Traces
Summary: Packet traces from the HVAC management system of a university campus, anonymised with Crypto-PAN and truncated to headers for intrusion detection research.
Asset / Process: HVAC and building systems; Control systems and networks
Description:
HVAC Traces is a set of pcap files recorded on the network of the HVAC management system of a university campus. Gorby Kabasele Ndonda and Ramin Sadre describe the system in a 2019 arXiv paper, "A Public Network Trace of a Control and Automation System". The traces are meant for evaluating and validating network intrusion detection systems in automation settings.

For privacy, IP addresses are anonymised with Crypto-PAN and packet payloads are truncated, so the data keeps only packet headers. A table maps the anonymised addresses of interest to their roles: gateways, a control server, an S7 client and S7 server, several HMIs, NetBIOS nodes, DNS, NTP, HTTP and update servers.

A second table names uncommon ports seen in the traffic, mostly DCE/RPC, plus two proprietary ports and an update service over HTTP. The traces themselves are downloaded from a Google Drive folder linked in the repository.
